big-five.heading: Hunting the Big Five with us

p: [Buffalo](especies/bufalo) is the one we arrange most: Mozambique, Tanzania, South Africa, Zambia and Zimbabwe. We hunt [leopard](especies/leopardo) in Namibia and Mozambique, always over bait. [Lion](especies/leon) is tracked on foot in the Kalahari and in Limpopo.
[Elephant](especies/elefante) is hunted in Botswana and South Africa, and [rhino](especies/rinoceronte) can be added as a trophy in Limpopo, subject to availability.
If you have never hunted dangerous game, buffalo is the natural first step. In Coutada 10 at Marromeu there is a five-day programme with one buffalo included.
The longer Mozambique programmes, of ten or fourteen days, let you put buffalo, leopard and plains game into a single trip.

faq.q: Can you hunt all five on one trip?
faq.a: In practice, no. Most hunters combine two or three, such as buffalo and leopard in Mozambique.

faq.q: Which of the Big Five can be hunted with a bow?
faq.a: Buffalo in Mozambique and South Africa, and tracked lion in Limpopo. You will find them under [bowhunting](caza-con-arco).

sections.h: Europe: close to home, with good trophies
p: For a short trip, Eastern Europe is hard to beat: [roebuck](especies/corzo) by weight in Hungary and Poland, [red deer](especies/ciervo) in the rut in Romania and Belarus, [chamois](especies/rebeco) in the Carpathians and the Balkans, and [bear](especies/oso) in Romania and Croatia.
Most are programmes of three hunting days that fit easily into a week.

If you want to go further afield, Central Asia has [ibex](especies/ibex) and Marco Polo sheep. In Africa, the [antelope](especies/antilopes) of Namibia and South Africa. In Canada and Greenland, [moose, caribou and muskox](especies/alce-caribu-muskox).
Each species has its own page listing the countries and programmes where we hunt it.

faq.q: Which species do you recommend for a first hunting trip abroad?
faq.a: Antelope in Namibia or roebuck in Hungary. Both are comfortable, short trips with a high success rate.

faq.q: Do you handle importing the trophy into Spain?
faq.a: We advise you at every step, although the Spanish permits are the hunter's responsibility. Each programme explains how it works.

p: We hunt [woodcock](especies/becada) in the Strandja mountains of Bulgaria, over pointing dogs and with no bag limit. [Capercaillie](especies/urogallo) is hunted in the spring display in the Rhodopes, also in Bulgaria.
For [wildfowl and pheasant](especies/acuaticas-y-faisanes), it is West Norfolk in England, an hour from Stansted.
These are three-day programmes, easy to fit around a long weekend.
In England, guns and cartridges are included, so you don't need to travel with a gun.

faq.q: When is the best time for woodcock in Bulgaria?
faq.a: From 15 November to 15 February.

faq.q: Can capercaillie be combined with another species?
faq.a: Yes. From 1 May you can add roebuck and wild boar in the Rhodopes.

p: Botswana is one of Africa's great ivory destinations. The [Botswana programme](caza-en-africa/botswana/botswana-elefante-10-dias) has ten hunting days, the time a quality elephant needs.
Terms change from one year to the next, so it is worth asking us about current offers.
In Limpopo we hunt elephant from a [luxury lodge](caza-en-africa/sudafrica/sudafrica-elefantes), on private land bordering Kruger National Park.
From there you can go on to [buffalo](especies/bufalo) or antelope on the same trip.

faq.q: How many days does an elephant hunt take?
faq.a: In Botswana we plan ten hunting days.

faq.q: Can the trophy be imported into Spain?
faq.a: It needs CITES permits. We explain the process before you book.

p: These are the three countries we recommend most. In Mozambique we hunt Coutada 10 at Marromeu, in the Zambezi Delta, with [5-day](caza-en-africa/mozambique/mozambique-bufalo-en-5-dias) and [7 or 10-day packages](caza-en-africa/mozambique/mozambique-bufalos-pack-7-y-10-dias).

In Tanzania, the [buffalo special](caza-en-africa/tanzania/tanzania-especial-bufalos) in the Mlele Game Reserve includes two buffalo per hunter. In South Africa there are hard-bossed buffalo in Limpopo and tracked buffalo in the Kalahari.
In Zambia, buffalo is combined with hippo and crocodile over seven days. Zimbabwe also has its own buffalo special.
With the bow, buffalo is hunted in the Zambezi reed beds and tracked on foot in Limpopo.

faq.q: When is the best time for buffalo?
faq.a: In Mozambique, May to November. In Tanzania, September and October.

faq.q: How many days do I need?
faq.a: Five days is usually enough for one buffalo. If you want to add leopard or plains game, seven or ten is better.

p: In the Kalahari the lions roam free on a 20,000-hectare property. You follow the tracks with native trackers until you find them.
The [Kalahari programme](caza-en-africa/sudafrica/sudafrica-leones-y-bufalo-kalahari) can include tracked buffalo as well.
For bowhunters, [tracked lion](caza-con-arco/sudafrica/sudafrica-arco-leones) on 60,000 hectares next to Kruger, for both lions and lionesses.
It is five hunting days and a seven-day stay. A very intense hunt.

faq.q: Are the lions fenced in?
faq.a: No. We track them on foot, on large properties where they live free.

faq.q: How long is the programme?
faq.a: Four to five hunting days, and a stay of six to seven days.

p: [Leopard in Namibia](caza-en-africa/namibia/namibia-leopardo) is hunted over bait, with a minimum of ten hunting days.
The lodge is 40 km from Windhoek airport, and you can add [antelope](especies/antilopes) from the general programme.
In Coutada 10 at Marromeu and in Nairoto, leopard is part of the [general programme](caza-en-africa/mozambique/mozambique-programa-general), of 7, 10 or 14 days.
There, most hunters pair it with [buffalo](especies/bufalo).

faq.q: Why does it take so many days?
faq.a: Because the baits have to be hung first, and then you wait for the leopard to come in. Ten days gives you time.

faq.q: What is the season in Mozambique?
faq.a: From 1 May to 30 November.

p: Rhino has no programme of its own. It is added to a hunt in Limpopo, on private land bordering Kruger National Park.

Most often it goes with the [Limpopo general programme](caza-en-africa/sudafrica/sudafrica-limpopo-programa-general) or the [buffalo from a luxury lodge](caza-en-africa/sudafrica/sudafrica-bufalo-lodge-de-lujo).
Availability and terms change. Please ask us before you finalise the trip.
It is also possible with the bow, as part of the luxury lodge packages.

faq.q: Where is rhino hunted?
faq.a: In Limpopo, South Africa.

faq.q: Are there places every season?
faq.a: It depends on the year. We will confirm availability when you get in touch.

p: For antelope we recommend Namibia. There are 80,000 hectares of open farmland 40 km from Windhoek, and the stalking is the real thing.

The [budget package](caza-en-africa/namibia/namibia-paquete-economico) includes an oryx, two springbok, a baboon and a jackal in four days. The [Windhoek package](caza-en-africa/namibia/namibia-paquete-windhoek) is six days, one-to-one.
Limpopo has around 34 possible species and a luxury lodge, for bowhunters too.
In Mozambique, antelope are added to a buffalo hunt. In Zambia, sable and lechwe stand out.

faq.q: Is it a good destination for a family trip?
faq.a: Namibia is: the lodge is close to the airport and companions can go sightseeing.

faq.q: What is the season in Namibia?
faq.a: February to November.

p: In southern Mauritania, 110 km from Nouakchott, the [warthog special](caza-en-africa/mauritania/mauritania-especial-facocheros) includes five per hunter over four days.
The camp is a luxury one, and the area is safe and free of malaria.
In Mauritania, [warthog with the bow](caza-con-arco/mauritania/mauritania-arco-facochero) are stalked morning and evening, closing in while they feed.
In South Africa we have a bowhunting special, currently on hold because of the drought.

faq.q: When is the season in Mauritania?
faq.a: November to March.

faq.q: How many warthog are included?
faq.a: Five per hunter on the rifle programme.

p: Very few countries allow cheetah hunting. In [Namibia](caza-en-africa/namibia/namibia-guepardo) we ask for a minimum of six days.
The lodge is 40 km from the airport, and antelope can be added.
In British Columbia we hunt [cougar, lynx and bobcat](caza-en-america/canada/canada-british-columbia-puma-lince-gato-montes) with hounds, tracking by 4x4 and snowmobile. You need to be fit.
In La Pampa, cougar is part of the [Argentina general programme](caza-en-america/argentina/argentina-programa-general).

faq.q: What is the season in British Columbia?
faq.a: From 15 November to 15 February.

faq.q: How many days does cheetah take?
faq.a: Six at least.

p: These are the two destinations we recommend. In Kazakhstan, [Siberian ibex](caza-en-asia/kazakhstan/kazakhstan-ibex-zonas-premium) are hunted in the Dzungarian Alatau, Narynkol and Kegen, on foot and on horseback.
In Turkey, [bezoar ibex](caza-en-asia/turquia/turquia-ibex-bezoar) carry trophies of 100 to 110 cm. November and December are best.
In Tajikistan ibex reach 135 cm, and in Kyrgyzstan they are hunted between 3,500 and 3,700 metres. In Mongolia, in the Altai or the Gobi.
There is also ibex in Iran, and Alpine ibex in Austria.

faq.q: Do I need to be fit?
faq.a: Yes. This is high-mountain hunting, and in Kyrgyzstan you go above 3,500 metres.

faq.q: Can it be combined with other species?
faq.a: In Tajikistan, with wild boar and wolf. In Mongolia, with black-tailed gazelle.

p: In North Macedonia, [Balkan chamois](caza-en-europa/macedonia/macedonia-caza-de-rebecos) are hunted on the alpine estate of Karadžica, with no points limit.
In Romania, the [Carpathian chamois](caza-en-europa/rumania/rumania-rebeco-carpatico) is the world's largest in body and trophy. It is hunted between 1,500 and 2,400 metres.

sections.h: The Alps, the Pyrenees and New Zealand
p: Alpine chamois in Slovenia, Italy, Austria and France, and Balkan chamois in Bulgaria and Croatia too.
In Spain, Pyrenean and Cantabrian chamois. And in New Zealand, alongside tahr on the South Island.

faq.q: When is the best time?
faq.a: Across most of Europe, September to November. Pyrenean chamois, in May and June.

faq.q: How many days do I need?
faq.a: Two or three hunting days.

p: We hunt Spanish ibex on a [private estate in Gredos](caza-en-europa/espana/espana-macho-montes-gredos-finca-privada), with horses, a guide and airport pick-up.
The season runs from September to March.
It is one of the great bowhunting challenges in Spain. The [bowhunting programme](caza-con-arco/espana/espana-arco-macho-montes) is on the same estate.
It takes two or three days.

faq.q: Where is it hunted?
faq.a: On a private estate in the Sierra de Gredos.

faq.q: How long does it take?
faq.a: Two or three days.

p: In Tajikistan, [Marco Polo](caza-en-asia/tayikistan/tayikistan-marco-polo) has had 100% success over the last 12 years, with average trophies of 55–56 inches.
In New Zealand, Himalayan tahr are hunted in the Southern Alps as part of the [general programme](caza-en-oceania/nueva-zelanda/nueva-zelanda-programa-general).

sections.h: Tur, Dall sheep and Balearic goat
p: Caucasian tur are hunted in Azerbaijan and Russia, on foot or on horseback. Dall sheep, in the Yukon.
And without leaving Spain, the [Balearic goat](caza-en-europa/espana/espana-boc-balear) in Mallorca, all year round.

faq.q: When is the best time for Marco Polo?
faq.a: From September to mid-December, and also in February and March.

faq.q: And for the Balearic goat?
faq.a: It is hunted all year. November, March and April are best.

p: It is our number one destination for wild boar. There are [driven hunts on reserves](caza-en-asia/turquia/turquia-batidas-jabali-caza-en-reservas) for groups of 8 to 14 hunters and [mixed hunts](caza-en-asia/turquia/turquia-jabali-caza-mixta) combining drives and night stalking.
On the [VIP night programme](caza-en-asia/turquia/turquia-jabali-vip-caza-nocturna) the average tusk is over 23 cm.
For really big boar, Iran and Tajikistan. Sitting up and driven hunts in Romania, Bulgaria and North Macedonia, and driven hunts in Tunisia.
In Argentina a great many feral pigs are taken. With the bow, sitting up an hour from Madrid and at night in Turkey.

faq.q: When is the driven season in Turkey?
faq.a: From 15 October to 15 February. Night hunting runs all year.

faq.q: How many boar are taken on a drive in Turkey?
faq.a: A good result is one boar per hunter per day.

p: We hunt the September rut in [Romania](caza-en-europa/rumania/rumania-caza-de-ciervo), in Belarus with stags of 12 to 14 kg, in Bulgaria and in Austria.
In Spain, [big stags](caza-en-europa/espana/espana-grandes-venados) an hour from Madrid, with a gold-medal stag as the aim.
The biggest red stags in the world are in [New Zealand](caza-en-oceania/nueva-zelanda/nueva-zelanda-programa-general), where the roar is in March and April.
In Argentina, red stag in the Andes near Esquel and in La Pampa. And maral in Kazakhstan.

faq.q: When is the roar in New Zealand?
faq.a: In March and April, the opposite of Europe.

faq.q: Can red deer be hunted with the bow?
faq.a: Yes, in Spain and in New Zealand.

p: In [Hungary](caza-en-europa/hungria/hungria-corzos-a-peso) we hunt the Great Plain, home to the country's best roebuck. In [Poland](caza-en-europa/polonia/polonia-caza-de-corzos-a-peso), from 11 May.
In both, the trophy is charged by weight, and Romania has roebuck on the plains and in the lower mountains.
In England, roebuck is combined with muntjac. In Scotland, with red deer.
In Spain we have [big roebuck](caza-en-europa/espana/espana-grandes-corzos) an hour from Madrid. And in Mongolia, Siberian roe deer.

faq.q: When does the season start in Hungary?
faq.a: On 15 April, and it runs until 30 September.

faq.q: How is the trophy weighed?
faq.a: With the full skull, 24 hours after boiling.

p: [Fallow deer in Romania](caza-en-europa/rumania/rumania-rececho-de-gamo) are hunted where «Fallow Buck Paradise» was filmed. A new national record was taken there in 2023.
The rut runs from 25 September to 15 November. There are fallow deer in Bulgaria, Austria and New Zealand too.
In Spain, [big mouflon](caza-en-europa/espana/espana-grandes-muflones) an hour from Madrid, stalked in the rut or from a high seat.
In Croatia, mouflon can be added to chamois at Biokovo. With the bow, from a blind or stalked in Spain.

faq.q: When is the mouflon rut?
faq.a: In October and November.

faq.q: Can mouflon be hunted all year?
faq.a: In Bulgaria, yes. In Spain, from a high seat outside the rut.

p: Both are hunted in England, on West Norfolk estates. Muntjac all year round; CWD from November to March.
On the [muntjac and CWD programme](caza-en-europa/inglaterra/inglaterra-caza-de-muntjac-y-cwd), guide, rifle and ammunition are included.
Between April and October, muntjac can be added to [roebuck in England](caza-en-europa/inglaterra/inglaterra-caza-de-corzos).
We recommend not bringing your own rifle, as UK entry formalities are slow.

faq.q: How many days is it?
faq.a: Three at least.

faq.q: Which is the nearest airport?
faq.a: Stansted.

p: Blackbuck are hunted in the marshes and farmland of Buenos Aires province, alongside feral pigs, axis deer and rams.
You will find it under [feral pigs and antelope](caza-en-america/argentina/argentina-chanchos-y-antilopes), from April to July.
In La Pampa, the [general programme](caza-en-america/argentina/argentina-programa-general) includes blackbuck along with red stag, wild boar, buffalo and cougar.
You stay in the estancia house.

faq.q: What is the season?
faq.a: From mid-April to the end of July.

faq.q: How many days is it?
faq.a: The La Pampa general programme has a minimum of five days.

p: Romania has Europe's largest brown bear population, around 8,000. We hunt them [from a hide](caza-en-europa/rumania/rumania-osos-en-espera) and [on drives](caza-en-europa/rumania/rumania-caza-de-oso-en-batida) in the Carpathians.
In Croatia, from high seats over bait. Most bears taken there make a medal.
Black bear in Quebec, with a Spanish guide from Madrid airport onwards. Grizzly in the Yukon and Kodiak bear from a boat in Alaska.
In Russia, Siberian brown bear around Baikal and in the Altai, and the black grizzly of Manchuria.

faq.q: When is bear hunted in Romania?
faq.a: In spring, 15 March to 14 May, and in autumn, 1 October to 31 December.

faq.q: Can bear be hunted with the bow?
faq.a: Yes, black bear in Quebec.

p: This is the destination we recommend. There is [wolf from a hide](caza-en-europa/macedonia/macedonia-lobo-en-espera) on the southern plains, 80 km from Skopje, with a one-to-one guide.
There are also [driven wolf and boar hunts](caza-en-europa/macedonia/macedonia-lobo-y-jabali-en-batida) with dogs in the centre of the country.
In Mongolia, [driven wolf hunts](caza-en-asia/mongolia/mongolia-batidas-de-lobos) on the steppe, with one wolf included.
In British Columbia, wolf can be added to the general programme.

faq.q: When is wolf hunted from a hide in North Macedonia?
faq.a: From 15 October to 31 March.

faq.q: Can the trophy be exported?
faq.a: Yes, with a CITES permit, which has its own fee in the programme.

p: We hunt muskox there [in spring](caza-en-europa/groenlandia/groenlandia-muskox-en-primavera), over frozen lakes, and [in summer](caza-en-europa/groenlandia/groenlandia-muskox-en-verano) with a helicopter.
[Caribou at Narsarsuaq](caza-en-europa/groenlandia/groenlandia-caribous) are hunted in August and September.
European moose in the rut in Belarus, and moose in the Yukon, home to the biggest in the world, with the bow as well.
Belarus also has European bison, one of the most special hunts in Europe.

faq.q: Can muskox be hunted with the bow?
faq.a: Yes, in summer at Kangerlussuaq.

faq.q: When is the moose rut in Belarus?
faq.a: From 8 to 20 September.

p: We shoot woodcock in the oak woods of the Strandja mountains, in south-eastern Bulgaria, over pointing dogs.
The [woodcock programme](caza-en-europa/bulgaria/bulgaria-becadas) has no bag limit.
It is four nights with three days' shooting, with professional guides.
Very easy to arrange for a group of friends.

faq.q: What is the season?
faq.a: From 15 November to 15 February.

faq.q: Is there a bag limit?
faq.a: No, there is no limit.

p: [Capercaillie](caza-en-europa/bulgaria/bulgaria-urogallo) are hunted during the display in the Bulgarian Rhodopes, in conifer forest between 1,200 and 2,200 metres.
It is a spring hunt, while the cock birds are displaying.
From 1 May you can add roebuck and wild boar.
In Russia, capercaillie and black grouse are an option within other programmes.

faq.q: When is the best time?
faq.a: From 15 April to 5 May.

faq.q: How long is the trip?
faq.a: Four nights and three hunting days.

p: The [wildfowling days](caza-en-europa/inglaterra/inglaterra-caza-de-acuaticas) are on West Norfolk estates, an hour from Stansted, with a local guide per hunter.
Mallard, wigeon, teal, greylag and Canada goose are guaranteed.

sections.h: No need to bring a gun
p: Guns and cartridges are included.
It can be combined with muntjac and CWD.

faq.q: When is the best time?
faq.a: Wildfowl in October and November; pheasant from November to January.

faq.q: How many days do I need to book?
faq.a: Two at least.
